"Catalogues and Counters" is scholarly and even interesting (a rare blend). I can't say it's a book I'd sit down and read cover to cover (mainly because it's so densely packed with stats and info), but it makes a great reference book.
My hat is off to Boris Emmet for taking such care to preserve so many details of the history of Sears and Roebuck.
Rose Thornton
author, The Houses That Sears Built
